prompt: Revise this customer message to acknowledge the problem without promising an uncertain result: 'Your parcel has not arrived. We have asked the delivery service to investigate. They have not yet given a date. We will send another update by Friday even if the investigation is unfinished.' A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
We’re sorry your parcel hasn’t arrived, and we understand how frustrating it is to be waiting without a clear delivery date. We’ve asked the delivery service to investigate, but they haven’t yet confirmed when your parcel may arrive.

At this stage, we can’t promise a delivery date or say when the investigation will be completed. We’ll send you another update by Friday, even if the investigation is still ongoing or there’s no new information to share. That update will explain what we know and whether the delivery service has provided any further details.

Thank you for your patience while we seek more information. We’re sorry for the inconvenience and uncertainty this delay has caused.
